messages.subject: [GenABEL-dev] Error when loading
messages.body_plain:
Hi All,

I've just started using GenABEL, and so far it's been a bit of a rough go. When I try to load the package, I get this error:

Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'GenABEL', details:
  call: stringSplit[[1]]
  error: subscript out of bounds
Error: package/namespace load failed for 'GenABEL'


However, at one point, it was working for me yesterday, but won't load today! I'm not sure what changed. 
I know that this error has been mentioned before, both in this list-serve and in other places, but I can't seem to find a post where it's been resolved. I'm using R v. 2.13.2, and I've tried GenABEL versions 1.7-0, 1.7-3, 1.7-6.

Thank you for your help!

Eryn
